title: DeAR: Debiasing Vision-Language Models with Additive Residuals

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the skew (MaxSkew and MinSkew) of cosine similarities between image and text representations across binary gender labels (male, female) using the FairFace and the proposed PATA datasets.

Measuring the skew (MaxSkew and MinSkew) of cosine similarities between image and text representations across different ethno-racial labels (e.g., White, Black, Indian, East Asian) using the FairFace and the proposed PATA datasets.
Measuring the skew (MaxSkew and MinSkew) of cosine similarities between image and text representations across different age group labels using the FairFace and the proposed PATA datasets.
